<parameter name="root_cause">The rebirth threshold is not correctly enforced in the server rebirth handler. The earlier fix to RebirthConfig.luau did not change the outcome: a rebirth with cash 9999 (cost 10000) still succeeded, rebirths went from 0 to 1 and cash was reset to about 15. This points to RebirthService's request path, not the shared config. The likely mistakes are a missing or incorrect cash >= cost check, a check against a different value such as lifetime earnings or a client-supplied value, or an altar or remote path that calls the rebirth routine without the check. I have not read RebirthService or probed it, so this is inferred from the rejected fix and not proven.</parameter>
